description: This file defines and registers the Anthropic plugin for the openclaw platform, including model resolution, authentication methods, and provider configuration.

methods.name: resolveAnthropic46ForwardCompatModel
methods.description: Resolves a forward-compatible model for Anthropic models, replacing model IDs with templates if applicable.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicForwardCompatModel
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate Anthropic model based on dynamic context, supporting backward compatibility.

methods.name: matchesAnthropicModernModel
methods.description: Checks if a given model ID matches the list of modern Anthropic models.

methods.name: buildAnthropicAuthDoctorHint
methods.description: Generates a hint message for authentication issues related to Anthropic profiles.

methods.name: runAnthropicCliMigration
methods.description: Performs migration of authentication via Claude CLI, ensuring CLI is authenticated.

methods.name: runAnthropicCliMigrationNonInteractive
methods.description: Performs non-interactive migration of authentication, updating configuration accordingly.

methods.name: registerAnthropicPlugin
methods.description: Registers the Anthropic plugin with the openclaw platform, setting up models, authentication, and provider configuration.
